description: This file defines hooks for the test automation framework, providing setup and teardown procedures for each test scenario within the test suite. It manages WebDriver lifecycle and captures screenshots upon test failures.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: A class that contains setup and teardown methods (hooks) for test scenarios, handling WebDriver initialization, cleanup, and failure screenshot attachment.

methods.name: BeforeScenario
methods.description: Method that runs before each test scenario to initialize the WebDriver.

methods.name: AfterScenario
methods.description: Method that runs after each test scenario to attach failure screenshots if the scenario failed, and then clean up the WebDriver.
